```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggprism)
library(rstatix)

# 1. Assign result_ggt to plot_data
plot_data <- result_ggt

# 2. Define panel and unit_map required for titles and y-axis labels
panel <- "ggt"
unit_map <- list("ggt" = "GGT (U/L)")

# 3. Standardize 'diabetes' values for statistical grouping
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    diabetes = case_when(
      diabetes %in% c("Diabetic", "diabetic", "yes", "Yes", TRUE) ~ "Diabetic",
      diabetes %in% c("Non_Diabetic", "non_diabetic", "Non-Diabetic", "no", "No", FALSE) ~ "Non_Diabetic",
      TRUE ~ as.character(diabetes)
    ),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c("Diabetic", "Non_Diabetic"))
  )

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Y AXIS SETTINGS
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

y_max        <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min        <- min(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
label_space  <- y_max * 0.20

y_bottom_plot <- y_min - label_space
y_top_plot    <- y_max * 1.25

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# N COUNTS (PATIENTS)
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

N_counts <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(diabetes) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("N=", N),
    y = y_bottom_plot - label_space * 1.30
  )

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# n COUNTS (OBSERVATIONS)
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

n_counts <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(diabetes) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("label=", "n=", n), # or paste0("n=", n)
    label = paste0("n=", n),
    y = y_max * 1.17
  )

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# P VALUES
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

counts <- table(plot_data$diabetes)

if (length(counts) < 2 || any(counts < 3)) {
  message("Skipping p-value — insufficient observations: ", 
          paste(names(counts), counts, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
  pvals <- tibble()
} else {
  pvals <- wilcox_test(plot_data, labreads ~ diabetes) %>%
    mutate(
      group1     = "Diabetic",
      group2     = "Non_Diabetic",
      y.position = y_max * 1.10,
      p.label    = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
    )
}

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# UNIT LABEL & TITLE
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) && panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
  unit_map[[panel]]
} else {
  toupper(panel)
}

plot_title <- paste0(
  toupper(panel),
  ": Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic"
)

#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLOT
#═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = diabetes, y = labreads, fill = diabetes)) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.30, 
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    alpha = 0.5, 
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.3,
    size  = 1.8,
    color = "#CC79A7"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = n_counts,
    aes(x = diabetes, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size      = 7,
    fontface  = "bold"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = N_counts,
    aes(x = diabetes, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size      = 7,
    fontface  = "bold"
  ) +

  { if (nrow(pvals) > 0)
      stat_pvalue_manual(
        pvals,
        label      = "p.label",
        xmin       = "group1",
        xmax       = "group2",
        y.position = "y.position",
        size       = 5,
        tip.length = 0.01
      )
  } +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(y_bottom_plot, y_top_plot),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x     = NULL,
    y     = y_label
  ) +

  theme_prism() +

  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 22, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 2)),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 40, l = 15)
  )

print(p)

```

```{r}
all_data %>%
```
```{r}
    full_join(diabetic_data,
              by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    full_join(gender_data1,
              by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(
      panel_id == "gpt",
      grepl("Leber_", treatment),
      !str_detect(attribute, "_from_start|dbs"),
      !is.na(diabetes),
      !is.na(treatment),
      !is.na(labreads)
    )%>% 
  filter(grepl("Leber", treatment)) %>% 
  select(bf_ar_m_nummer, treatment, labreads) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>% 
  summarise(
    treatment_count = n(),
    labreads_count  = sum(!is.na(labreads)),
    patient_count   = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
